_comment: FORGE optional Claude Code adapter (design TASK-011 D5). Merge the hooks entry into the project's .claude/settings.json. Warn-only: echoes the next required gate before a git commit when a governed task is in progress. Other harnesses: invoke assets/scripts/forge_next_gate.py from the equivalent hook surface; git pre-commit and CI remain the durable enforcement.

hooks.command: sh -c 'task=$(git diff --cached --name-only | grep -m1 "^docs/forge/tasks/.*\.ya\?ml$"); if [ -n "$task" ] && [ -f "$task" ]; then next=$(python3 "$(ls -d ~/.claude/skills/forge ~/.agents/skills/forge 2>/dev/null | head -1)/assets/scripts/forge_next_gate.py" "$task" 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$next" ] && [ "$next" != "checkpoint-complete" ] && echo "FORGE: next required gate for $task: $next"; fi; exit 0'
